# Algorithyum — Enterprise Software Architecture & AI Engineering Platform

> Algorithyum is a global enterprise technology consulting and software engineering firm specializing in bespoke software development, generative AI agent orchestration, cloud native architectures, zero-trust cybersecurity, and digital transformation.

## Primary Entities & Corporate Information
- **Name**: Algorithyum Systems Group
- **Website**: https://algorithyum.in
- **Core Domain**: Enterprise Software Architecture, Artificial Intelligence, Cloud Infrastructure
- **Headquarters**: San Francisco, CA (USA) & Global Operations
- **Contact**: contact@algorithyum.in

## Core Capability Pillars

### 1. Custom Software Development
- **URL**: https://algorithyum.in/services/software-development
- **Overview**: Full-cycle bespoke application development using modern stacks (React, Next.js, Node.js, Go, Python, PostgreSQL). High-throughput microservices, scalable API gateways, and web/mobile apps.

### 2. Generative AI & Autonomous AI Agents
- **URL**: https://algorithyum.in/services/ai-agent-development
- **Overview**: Enterprise LLM fine-tuning, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, multi-agent workflow systems (LangChain, LlamaIndex, OpenAI, Anthropic), and automated decision pipelines.

### 3. Cloud Native Architecture & DevOps
- **URL**: https://algorithyum.in/services/cloud-native-architecture
- **Overview**: Cloud infrastructure on AWS, GCP, and Azure. Multi-region Kubernetes cluster orchestration, Terraform IaC, automated CI/CD pipelines, and cost optimization.

### 4. Zero-Trust Cybersecurity
- **URL**: https://algorithyum.in/services/cybersecurity
- **Overview**: Penetration testing, end-to-end encryption, SOC2/HIPAA compliance engineering, identity access management (IAM), and continuous vulnerability scanning.

### 5. Data Engineering & Big Data Systems
- **URL**: https://algorithyum.in/services/data-engineering
- **Overview**: Enterprise data warehouse design (BigQuery, Snowflake), real-time streaming pipelines (Kafka, Flink), ETL/ELT data pipelines, and analytics infrastructure.

## System Standards & Compliance
- Security: Zero-Trust architecture, TLS 1.3, AES-256 at rest, SOC2 compliant design.
- Quality: Automated testing, code review standards, 99.99% uptime target for client infrastructure.
